Эпиктет, Енхиридіонъ, перевод Григория Полетики, 1767, печатные главы 1–5, стр. 55–59; самостоятельная транскрипция по цифровому экземпляру РНБ.
Only the first standard chapter of the Enchiridion, corresponding to printed chapters 1–5 on pages 55–59 of Poletyka’s 1767 edition. Historical spelling is retained; printed section headings, line wraps and stress marks are omitted. The rest of the work is not represented by this witness. The scan images remain in local artifact custody; this is an independent manual transcription.
restrictions: Identify the 1767 translator and the source; preserve the limited coverage.
rationale: The translator died in 1784; the 1767 translation is public domain in Russia and in the United States. The independent textual transcription does not reproduce the modern library images.
